envelope.description: Extend git_stash, git_worktree, git_remote, git_branch and git_tag

body.title: Extend git_stash, git_worktree, git_remote, git_branch and git_tag
body.summary: Use extendGitTool to add the missing ops: stash (branch, create, store, export, import), worktree (lock, unlock, repair), remote (show, prune, update, set-head, set-branches, set-url --add, set-url --delete), branch (rename, copy, set-upstream-to, unset-upstream, edit-description) and tag (verify, sign). Remote prune is destructive. Re-pin the input snapshots with the new inputs listed as added by s8, and mark the rows covered with cases; only this Task's own rows are checked.
acceptanceChecks: Every input that was valid for the five tools gives the same result and class as before
Each new op has a coverage case that checks its effect
The pinned input snapshot lists the new inputs as added by s8 and no existing input changed

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-coverage.test.ts: the new ops of git_stash, git_worktree, git_remote, git_branch and git_tag change the repository as the command does
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-approval.test.ts: the pinned inputs of the five extended tools are unchanged and the new inputs are listed as added by s8
